title: The Mint and Silver New Year's Eve Glam Getting-Ready Station
description: A mint and silver New Year's Eve getting-ready setup from Amazon: a sage green satin robe, a mint light-up tri-fold mirror, a Kitsch heatless curls set, rhinestone claw clips, holographic body glitter and a silver puffy makeup bag.
intro: Last New Year's Eve I was curling my hair in the bathroom with the overhead light, the worst light known to woman, while my friends were already texting "where are you." Never again. This year the getting-ready part is half the party. Satin robe on, heatless curls in since the afternoon, a mint light-up mirror on the dresser, rhinestone clips in every color and a little glitter, obviously. Champagne optional. Being late is not.

sections.heading: The hair part
paragraphs: The Kitsch satin heatless curls set in Aura, a 34 in curling rod plus 2 satin scrunchies. Wrap it in the afternoon, take it out at 8 and you've got bouncy curls with zero heat. Then pile half of it up with a rhinestone claw clip. The 4 pack comes in rose gold, gold, silver and gunmetal, 3.5 in each, so there's one for every outfit change.

sections.heading: The glam part
paragraphs: A mint tri-fold vanity mirror with 21 LED lights and 2X and 3X side mirrors (11 in tall), so you can actually see your eyeliner. LANGMANNI holographic body glitter gel in Sparkling Pink for cheekbones, collarbones and hair parts. Everything lives in a silver puffy quilted makeup bag that's about 10 in wide and fits way more than it looks like.

sections.heading: The cozy part
paragraphs: A sage green satin robe, because you can't get ready for a party in a hoodie. It has pockets and a tie belt, and it makes the whole thing feel like an event before you even leave the house.

sections.heading: Shop it
paragraphs: Every piece is linked below, and every look I make lives on my Amazon storefront: https://www.amazon.com/shop/thedigitalincomeedit

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, props, champagne, dress and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Photos are AI-generated styling ideas; check each listing for the exact item.
